offence_note: Sexual interference, invitation to sexual touching, householder permitting prohibited sexual activity
sentence_quote: for Count 1, sexual interference under s. 151, two years less a day; · for Count 2, invitation to sexual touching under s. 152, also two years less a day to be served concurrently
note: Deafness and immigration consequences considered; concurrent sentences.

offence_note: Two counts dangerous driving causing death
sentence_quote: leave to appeal sentence is granted, the conditional sentence is set aside and a sentence of imprisonment is imposed equivalent to the time remaining under the conditional sentence (101 days). The driving prohibition is increased to seven years.
note: Conditional sentence of 2 years less a day replaced by 101 days jail; prohibition raised from 5 to 7 years.

offence_note: Youth offenders; super-primary offences incl. assault causing bodily harm; DNA constitutionality
note: Crown appeals on constitutionality of DNA collection orders for young offenders; offences only partly shown.

offence_note: Three counts impaired driving causing death
sentence_quote: I sentence you to a further period of imprisonment of six years concurrent on each count.
systemic_quote: I have also given careful consideration to the testimony of your mother about her experience with residential schools and the effect that had on her and her parenting skills. I accept that this had an unfortunate effect on you
note: Driving prohibition 15 years plus the period of imprisonment; judge endorsed classification to KHV facility.

offence_note: Manslaughter of three year old daughter
sentence_quote: The appellant beat her three year old daughter to death. She was convicted of manslaughter and appeals from the ten year sentence imposed by the trial judge.
note: Credit 7 months pretrial custody plus 3 months for bail conditions.

sentence_quote: I would set aside the sentence imposed below and substitute a conditional sentence of twelve months.
note: 90 days intermittent plus probation replaced by 12 month conditional sentence.

sentence_quote: Leave to appeal sentence is granted but the appeal is also dismissed.
note: Conviction and sentence appeals dismissed; conditional sentence declined at trial.

offence_note: Aggravated assault (varied to assault causing bodily harm); breach of probation
sentence_quote: As ordered by the trial judge, the total sentence will be reduced by 543 days for time served while on remand.
note: Majority varies sentence to years less a day (number not shown); Green J.A. dissent ignored; Inuk offender.

offence_note: Multiple sexual offences against five young girls; dangerous offender
sentence_quote: I would dismiss the appeal from the dangerous offender designation and from the determinate sentence imposed under s. 753(4)(b) of the Code.
note: Dangerous offender designation with determinate sentence plus 10 year LTSO; total length not shown; K counts two years.

offence_note: Sexual assault, sexual interference, invitation to sexual touching of young cousin
sentence_quote: I would allow the appeal and reduce the appellant’s sentence of imprisonment to five and a half years, including credit for pre-sentence custody.
note: Effective six years less credit; lifetime SOIRA and s161 order not varied on appeal.
